page_title: Yado · Clean up your iPhone from your Mac

sources.entry: Yado - Native Mac app for managing an iPhone: clear duplicate photos, large videos and unused apps, arrange the Home Screen, move files and keep backups on the Mac. ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: Yado
summary.one_liner: Yado is a native Mac app for managing an iPhone from the Mac, covering photo export, duplicate and large video cleanup, unused app removal, Home Screen layout, file transfer and local backups.
use_cases: Free up iPhone storage without buying iCloud space
Remove duplicate and blurry photos from an iPhone
Move large videos from iPhone to a Mac
Uninstall unused apps on iPhone from a Mac
Back up an iPhone to a Mac or external drive
Arrange iPhone Home Screen folders from a computer
summary.what_it_does: Yado runs on a Mac and shows the iPhone's photos, videos, apps, Home Screen and backups in one window. It finds duplicate photos, picks the best shot in each group, and flags blurry or receipt-like photos. Videos over 100 MB are saved to the Mac first and removed from the phone only after the full original is verified. It lists apps that are unopened for four weeks or not updated in a year, and uninstalls them when ticked. It can group apps into folders, save and restore Home Screen layouts, and make scheduled or external-drive backups that stay on the Mac, with contacts, notes and messages readable from the backup.
notable: Photos and videos are copied to the Mac and only removed from the iPhone after the full original is confirmed
Backups stay on the Mac and can be read contact by contact, note by note and message by message
One-time $19 purchase with no subscription and a 14-day refund
Does not do flashing, jailbreaking or app downloads
caveats: Costs $19 one-time after a trial; the page lists a 14-day refund
Only iPhones are supported; other phones are not
Photos, restoring a backup and screenshots need a cable; Wi-Fi works only for some tasks
